# Introduction

The goal of this project is to write functions that will *manipulate* and *process* 
data from the Census Public Use Microdata Sample (PUMS) API, notably generic functions 
that will combine, summarize, and plot the queried data. The project will use PUMS 
data from 2021 through 2024.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(lubridate)
```
